toyota|land cruiser.headline: Toyota Land Cruiser in Kenya
toyota|land cruiser.summary: The Land Cruiser is Kenya's benchmark full-size 4x4 for estates, upcountry travel, and status-conscious buyers who want V8 torque and ladder-frame durability.
toyota|land cruiser.specs: Typical imports run 4.0L–4.6L petrol or 4.5L diesel V8 with permanent 4WD. Fuel use is heavy in Nairobi traffic (often 5–8 km/L on diesel V8 depending on driving).
toyota|land cruiser.kenyaNotes: Check frame rust, suspension bushings, and cooling system history. Many units are ex-Gulf or Japan imports — verify auction grade and service records before paying a deposit.
toyota|land cruiser.buyerTip: Compare against Prado if you need seven seats with lower running costs, or Land Cruiser 300 if budget allows a newer platform.

toyota|prado.headline: Toyota Prado in Kenya
toyota|prado.summary: Prado is the default family 4x4 in Kenya: seven-seat flexibility, strong resale, and wide workshop support from Nairobi to the coast.
toyota|prado.specs: Common trims include TX, TZ-G, and VX with 2.7L petrol or 2.8L diesel (GDJ150 era). Diesel is preferred for torque and fuel economy on long trips.
toyota|prado.kenyaNotes: Inspect rear differential whine, AdBlue system on newer diesels, and any accident repairs on the rear door and quarter panels. TX-L and TZ-G hold value best in Nairobi.
toyota|prado.buyerTip: Match trim to your use — TX for value, VX if you want premium cabin kit without full Land Cruiser running costs.

toyota|land-cruiser-prado.headline: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado in Kenya
toyota|land-cruiser-prado.summary: Prado is the default family 4x4 in Kenya: seven-seat flexibility, strong resale, and wide workshop support from Nairobi to the coast.
toyota|land-cruiser-prado.specs: Common trims include TX, TZ-G, and VX with 2.7L petrol or 2.8L diesel (GDJ150 era). Diesel is preferred for torque and fuel economy on long trips.
toyota|land-cruiser-prado.kenyaNotes: Inspect rear differential whine, AdBlue system on newer diesels, and any accident repairs on the rear door and quarter panels. TX-L and TZ-G hold value best in Nairobi.
toyota|land-cruiser-prado.buyerTip: Match trim to your use — TX for value, VX if you want premium cabin kit without full Land Cruiser running costs.

toyota|harrier.headline: Toyota Harrier in Kenya
toyota|harrier.summary: Harrier targets buyers who want a premium SUV footprint without Prado size. Strong demand in Nairobi for ZU60/ASU60 hybrid and petrol trims.
toyota|harrier.specs: Most listings are 2.0L/2.5L petrol or hybrid AWD. Hybrids suit stop-start commuting; petrol is simpler for upcountry workshops.
toyota|harrier.kenyaNotes: Hybrid battery health checks are essential on older imports. Panel alignment and paint meter readings help spot repaired auction units.
toyota|harrier.buyerTip: Cross-shop Vezel and Mazda CX-5 if you want a smaller bill with similar city use.

toyota|rav4.headline: Toyota RAV4 in Kenya
toyota|rav4.summary: RAV4 is the compact family SUV sweet spot — easier parking than Prado, still credible for light weekend travel.
toyota|rav4.specs: 2.0L and 2.5L petrol plus hybrid variants appear frequently. AWD is useful on murram but not a hardcore off-roader.
toyota|rav4.kenyaNotes: Timing chain service history matters on high-mileage petrol units. Confirm spare key and infotainment faults before handover.
toyota|rav4.buyerTip: Compare Honda CR-V and Mazda CX-5 listings at similar year and mileage.

mazda|cx-5.headline: Mazda CX-5 in Kenya
mazda|cx-5.summary: CX-5 offers sharp handling and a premium cabin feel at a lower price point than equivalent Harrier years — popular with Nairobi commuters.
mazda|cx-5.specs: 2.0L and 2.5L Skyactiv petrol dominate imports. Fuel economy is reasonable for class (roughly 9–12 km/L mixed use when maintained).
mazda|cx-5.kenyaNotes: Watch for worn rear shocks on rough estate roads and check for Mazda recall work on older KE registrations.
mazda|cx-5.buyerTip: A well-kept CX-5 often undercuts Harrier on total cost of ownership.

mazda|cx-8.headline: Mazda CX-8 in Kenya
mazda|cx-8.summary: CX-8 brings three-row seating in a road-biased package — alternative to Prado for families who rarely do serious off-road.
mazda|cx-8.specs: 2.5L turbo petrol is common on XDL trims. Expect premium pricing versus CX-5 for newer year bands.
mazda|cx-8.kenyaNotes: Third-row space suits children more than adults. Verify all power doors and tailgate on high-spec imports.
mazda|cx-8.buyerTip: If you need true 4x4 duty, Prado still wins; CX-8 wins on tarmac comfort.

honda|cr-v.headline: Honda CR-V in Kenya
honda|cr-v.summary: CR-V is the rational alternative to RAV4 — spacious cabin, strong reliability reputation, and steady resale in urban Kenya.
honda|cr-v.specs: 1.5L turbo and 2.4L petrol generations both appear. CVT models need disciplined transmission fluid history.
honda|cr-v.kenyaNotes: Check for flood damage on Japan imports and confirm VIN matches logbook before transfer.
honda|cr-v.buyerTip: Filter by year and mileage together — a cheap high-km CR-V can cost more in suspension and brakes.

honda|vezel.headline: Honda Vezel in Kenya
honda|vezel.summary: Vezel is a compact hybrid SUV staple for Nairobi — efficient in traffic and easy to park in tight estates.
honda|vezel.specs: 1.5L hybrid with i-DCD or S+ systems depending on generation. Battery and inverter checks are non-negotiable.
honda|vezel.kenyaNotes: Specialist hybrid diagnostics beat generic OBD scans. Confirm Kenya registration year vs manufacture month to avoid duty surprises on imports.
honda|vezel.buyerTip: Pair with a duty estimate if you are shipping rather than buying locally registered stock.

subaru|forester.headline: Subaru Forester in Kenya
subaru|forester.summary: Forester appeals to buyers who want symmetrical AWD and a practical wagon body for mixed tarmac and light murram.
subaru|forester.specs: 2.0L petrol and occasional turbo variants. Expect slightly higher parts cost than Toyota/Mazda mainstream models.
subaru|forester.kenyaNotes: Head gasket history on older EJ engines is a known talking point — demand compression and leak-down tests on suspect units.
subaru|forester.buyerTip: Great value if maintenance is documented; walk away from mystery overheating histories.

nissan|x-trail.headline: Nissan X-Trail in Kenya
nissan|x-trail.summary: X-Trail competes with RAV4 and Forester for family space with often softer pricing on equivalent years.
nissan|x-trail.specs: 2.0L and 2.5L petrol CVT models are common. Seven-seat variants exist but verify third-row condition.
nissan|x-trail.kenyaNotes: CVT fluid changes matter. Check air-conditioning performance before dry-season viewings.
nissan|x-trail.buyerTip: Use price-band filters to find value against Toyota-heavy shortlists.

mercedes-benz|e-class.headline: Mercedes-Benz E-Class in Kenya
mercedes-benz|e-class.summary: E-Class remains a prestige sedan and wagon choice for executives — strong street presence in Nairobi and Mombasa.
mercedes-benz|e-class.specs: Petrol and diesel four-cylinders and V6s appear depending on year. Budget for premium tyres, brakes, and electronic repairs.
mercedes-benz|e-class.kenyaNotes: Confirm spare key, COMAND/MBUX functionality, and any air-suspension faults on higher trims.
mercedes-benz|e-class.buyerTip: A full dealer service history justifies a premium over grey imports with unknown maintenance.

bmw|x5.headline: BMW X5 in Kenya
bmw|x5.summary: X5 is the performance-luxury SUV option for buyers cross-shopping Range Rover Sport and high-spec Prado VX.
bmw|x5.specs: xDrive AWD with petrol and diesel six-cylinders dominate. Running costs exceed mainstream Toyota SUVs.
bmw|x5.kenyaNotes: Cooling system, oil leaks, and electronic module faults are common negotiation points on older imports.
bmw|x5.buyerTip: Pre-purchase inspection at a BMW-aware workshop saves costly surprises after transfer.
